attributes.composition: Ta and Nb enriched in dendrite regions; Hf, V, Ti in interdendritic regions

evidence.quote: the as-cast alloys have notable elemental microsegregations. High-melting-point elements Ta (3269 K) and Nb (2741 K) are enriched in dendrite regions (DRs), while low-melting-point elements Hf (2500 K), V (2193 K), and Ti (1933 K) are accumulated in interdendritic regions (IRs).

For a sing-phase solid solution, V atoms interact with other alloying elements (Hf, Nb, Ta, and Ti) which prompts the distortion of crystal lattice and the formation of local strain fields, subsequently increases the resistance to dislocation movement, and results in enhanced hardness and yield strength. Accordingly, it can be assumed that the most likely strengthening mechanism is solid solution strengthening.
